risk_note: RV2 by path (payout module). Adds the read-only hasSucceeded to payout's WithdrawalReaders (withdrawal-in-flight.ts): one SELECT on the caller's transaction, app_id + user_id scoped, true when a withdrawal is PAID_API or PAID_MANUAL; no writes, no logs, no hold or payee lookup. app.module.ts replaces the hardcoded false used by identity's deletion side, so B1-15g now keeps the realname cipher for users with a paid-out withdrawal (D10-137 ②, as originally intended). Prerequisite for B1-27a (prior identity kept when a paid-out withdrawal exists, BR-ID-25). No contract, schema or migration. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
